cohort: 529 preterm infants (<33 weeks' gestational age) who received delayed cord clamping (DCC) for ≥30 seconds
finding: Neonatal outcomes in preterm infants receiving DCC were comparable between singletons and multiples, first and second order multiples and monochorionic and dichorionic/trichorionic multiples.
mod_finding: The study noted a higher rate of cesarean sections in multiples compared to singletons (91% vs 54%).
